text: fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { return a + b; }
fn subtract(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { return a - b; }
fn multiply(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { return a * b; }
fn divide(a: f64, b: f64) -> f64 { return a / b; }
fn increment(x: i32) -> i32 { return x + 1; }
fn decrement(x: i32) -> i32 { return x - 1; }
fn double(x: i32) -> i32 { return x * 2; }
fn half(x: f64) -> f64 { return x / 2.0; }
fn factorial(n: i32) -> i32 { if n <= 1 { return 1; } return n * factorial(n - 1); }
fn fibonacci(n: i32) -> i32 { if n <= 1 { return n; } return fibonacci(n-1) + fibonacci(n-2); }
